svg.title: Quality — six benchmarks, six models
svg.desc: All six vertical-bar panels share a fixed 0–100 score scale; higher is better. The two priority panels appear above four smaller panels. Full model names are shown in the shared legend; stable short names appear below the bars. DeepSWE 1.1: Edge0-145B: 64.6; Edge0-120B: 51.3; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 58.7; Qwen3.8-27B: 42.2; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 54.4; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): not reported. Terminal-Bench 2.1: Edge0-145B: 86.5; Edge0-120B: 75.3; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 83.3; Qwen3.8-27B: 73.0; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 82.7; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): 78.2. HLE: Edge0-145B: 35.4; Edge0-120B: 31.0; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 35.9; Qwen3.8-27B: 30.8; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 33.8; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): 40.0. GPQA-Diamond: Edge0-145B: 90.4; Edge0-120B: 87.4; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 91.7; Qwen3.8-27B: 89.2; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 90.8; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): 91.3. IFBench: Edge0-145B: 80.6; Edge0-120B: 79.3; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 81.3; Qwen3.8-27B: 79.5; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 79.2; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): 62.5. AA-LCR: Edge0-145B: 79.3; Edge0-120B: 81.0; Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: 79.1; Qwen3.8-27B: 82.0; DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731: 79.7; Claude-Opus-4.6 (Max): 78.0. Missing scores are not drawn as zero. Results are listed by model.
